preview_generation.fictional_product: unbranded sage-green rectangular rechargeable task light with a frosted white front diffuser, one black side button, and a simple black fold-out rear stand
preview_generation.policy: Self-generated previews are layout/style references only and cannot establish product facts.

previews.final_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: Amazon main-image layout preview. Primary request: create an unbranded preview using a fictional generic product: a sage-green rectangular rechargeable task light with frosted white front diffuser, one black side button, rounded aluminum body, and a simple black fold-out rear stand. Scene/backdrop: pure white seamless background. Composition: single complete product centered, dominant direction nearly fills the square while every edge remains visible, neutral front three-quarter view. Lighting: soft even catalog studio light with minimal natural contact shadow. Constraints: preserve a believable 3:2 face ratio; exactly one product; no props, packaging, logo, text, badge, price, promotion, watermark, or extra parts.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: home application layout preview. Input image 1: product identity reference; preserve its exact rectangular body, frosted front diffuser, sage-green frame, black side button, black fold-out rear stand, proportions, and silhouette. Primary request: place that same unbranded fictional generic product naturally on a calm modern home desk; change only the environment and camera framing. Composition: product is the clear hero, restrained notebook and plant only as quiet context, clean negative space above for later deterministic copy. Lighting: soft morning window light. Constraints: do not redesign, unfold into a tall lamp, rotate into a different form, or add controls; no readable text, logo, brand, price, promotion, watermark, or cables.
